name: Movsar Evloev

face.shape: Long, narrow face, oval to slightly rectangular. It is clearly taller than it is wide, with little width at the cheekbones and a gentle taper to the chin. The beard adds some width along the lower jaw; under it the face is lean and bony (2018 photo).
face.jaw: Narrow to medium width with clean, defined angles. In the 2018 photo (short stubble only) the jaw line is sharp and runs at a moderate slope from below the ears to the chin. In the October 2026 left profile the jaw angle sits well behind and below the ear lobe and is crisp under the beard.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly pointed, and moderately projecting. In left profile it sits a little in front of the lower lip line. It looks longer than average because of the beard and the darker vertical strip of hair under the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Defined but not wide. There are slight hollows below them in the studio headshot and a visible cheekbone highlight in the three-quarter views.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. The brows sit low and straight and the eyes look slightly deep-set under them. Two faint vertical creases between the brows give a mild frown at rest.
face.forehead: Hidden in every 2026 photo by the fringe or a cap. In the 2018 photo (short hair) it is medium height, fairly flat and slightly sloped, with no visible recession at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, medium size, with a moderate vertical opening. The upper lids show a small crease, the lower lids are fairly straight and there are faint shadows underneath. Outer corners are level.
eyes.colour: Light to medium brown with an amber tint in studio light (hazel-brown). Closest embed iris: mh-iris-brownlight.
eyes.expression: Calm, steady, slightly narrowed stare in all fight-week photos.

eyebrows.shape: Low and almost straight, with only a slight lift toward the outer third. The inner ends sit close together.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, matching the head hair

nose.length: Long; it is the most noticeable feature of the face.
nose.width: Medium at the tip and nostrils, narrow-to-medium along the bridge.
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly high from the front. In the October 2026 left profile and the March 2026 right three-quarter view it runs in an almost straight line from the brow to the tip.
nose.hump: Slight convexity at mid-bridge in profile; no big dorsal hump.
nose.tip: Rounded, moderately projecting, pointing slightly downward.
nose.fight_damage: None visible. The bridge is straight and symmetric in the frontal studio headshot.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, with a soft cupid's bow, partly shaded by the moustache.
mouth.lower_lip: Medium fullness, fuller than the upper lip.
mouth.resting_expression: Lips closed, corners level to very slightly down; a serious, neutral look. Smiles with closed lips (2018 photo).

ears.protrusion: Lie fairly close to the head; mostly covered by hair in studio photos.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower ear in any photo. The left ear in the October 2026 profile has a normal helix and lobe; the right ear in the March 2026 face-off also looks normal.
ears.notes: Ears are partly hidden by the hair in most photos, so treat them as normal medium ears.

face.notable_marks_scars: No visible facial scars or marks at these resolutions. Faint vertical frown lines between the brows. The bare jaw in 2018 shows no scars.

hair.style: Thick, longish, layered cut. In the UFC studio portraits (March and October 2026) it is blow-dried straight: a heavy fringe swept slightly to his right (viewer's left) falls to the eyebrows and covers the whole forehead, the sides cover the top half of the ears, and wispy ends curl out at the nape. In candid 2026 photos (London face-off, UFC 333 face-off and open workout) the same hair is naturally wavy to curly, with more volume, falling over the forehead and curling below the cap at the back.
hair.colour: Dark brown, near black in shadow, with warm chestnut-brown highlights in studio light.
hair.hairline: Hidden by the fringe in 2026. No recession visible in 2018.
hair.texture: Thick, naturally wavy to loosely curly; can be styled straight.
hair.notes: For the simulator, a medium-length wavy cut with a forehead-covering fringe reads more like his fight-week look than either of the embed short cuts. If only short01/02/04 are available, tint #2e1e1a and push the fringe forward. Wears a grey flat cap in face-offs.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown, close to the head-hair colour; skin shows through where it is thin on the upper jaw.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and along the lower jaw line, thinner and patchier on the cheeks and the upper jaw. The moustache is thin and sparse.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 8-12 mm in the 2026 studio portraits and about 10-15 mm (fuller) in the October 2026 face-off.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard following the jaw, with a low, soft cheek line. A darker vertical strip runs from just under the lower lip down to the chin (soul patch joining the chin beard). The moustache is thin and joins the beard at the mouth corners. The neckline sits on the upper neck under the jaw.

skin.undertone: Warm-neutral light skin. Studio photos show slightly pink cheeks; under stage light it reads more beige. Face and body are the same tone (no tan line).
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles or visible marks. Very little body hair on the chest and abdomen; light hair on the forearms and lower legs.
skin.texture_pick: young_caucasian_male or middleage_caucasian_male skin tinted toward #cb9178; keep it a little lighter and pinker on the cheeks than on the jaw, where the beard shadow sits.

body.build: Compact, lean and athletic featherweight with a grappler's thick upper body and a long reach (72 in) for his height (67 in), so the arms look long.
body.body_fat_notes: Very lean at fight week: clear six-pack, visible serratus and obliques, veins on the forearms (studio stances, October 2026 face-off).
body.shoulders: Broad for his height, with round, well-developed deltoids. Traps are moderate, not bulky.
body.chest: Well-developed, full pecs with a clear lower edge; the chest is the most muscular-looking part of the torso.
body.arms: Long arms with defined biceps and triceps and strong forearms. Not bulky.
body.waist: Narrow and tight, giving a clear V-taper from the shoulders.
body.legs_calves: Slim to medium thighs with visible quad separation; lean calves. Legs are slightly short for the long torso and arms.
body.neck: Medium thickness and fairly long; it looks long because of the narrow face.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed in studio, shoulders level, head slightly forward with the chin level. Back and lats are well developed (UFC 333 grapple photo).
body.notable_physique_traits: Long narrow face over a broad, muscular chest and shoulders; long arms; slim legs.

tattoos_note: None visible. The front of the torso and both arms are clear in the two studio stances, the left side and arm in the October 2026 face-off, and the full back in the UFC 333 grapple photo.
accessories_seen: Stainless-steel wristwatch with a dark dial on the left wrist and a grey plaid flat cap (October 2026 face-off). Brown long-sleeve rash guard and beige shorts at the UFC 333 open workout.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued black fight shorts with a tonal grey wave/scale pattern, a black waistband with white block pattern on both sides, a UFC wordmark on the front of the waistband, and a white crypto.com logo low on his RIGHT thigh (viewer's left when he faces the camera) in the 2026 studio portraits. At UFC 333 (October 2026) he fought in white shorts with a grey patterned print, a black waistband and black side panel lettered VENUM.
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC 4 oz gloves in studio; blue-cuffed gloves at UFC 333 (blue corner).
kit.brand_note: Describe the studio shorts as UFC-issued; the UFC 333 fight shorts carry a VENUM wordmark.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Standard MakeHuman ear modifiers, in case they are added later: ears look normal and lie close to the head.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, eye colour, skin tone range, build and the absence of tattoos; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. Photo count is modest: 9 photos, only one freely licensed (a small 2018 Commons image), the rest reference-only. 2026 coverage is good (studio front and three-quarter, a true left profile, a right three-quarter, two fight photos, one workout). There is no sharp frontal photo with the forehead visible, so forehead height is a guess. What to watch: (1) The likeness depends on the long, narrow face, the long straight nose and the low straight brows; a wide or round head stops looking like him. (2) The hair must cover the forehead down to the brows; with a short cut and an exposed forehead he looks like a different person. Natural texture is wavy, studio look is straight. (3) The beard is short and dark, denser on the chin and lower jaw with a darker strip under the lower lip, and thin on the cheeks; do not make it a dense full beard. (4) Light, warm-neutral skin; studio photos are high key, so tone_hex uses the average of studio and arena samples. (5) Body: lean, broad chest and shoulders, narrow waist, long arms, slim legs. No tattoos at all. Macro values: ageOldM uses avatar3d.js (age - 25) / 65 with age 32.7; heightDownM 0.27 matches the other 170 cm fighters (Tsarukyan); scale the final mesh to 170.2 cm if the avatar code supports it. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right; the values here are symmetric.
